old_problem: Named data and BMC ports lacked a target-versus-monitor role matrix; DeepSeek omitted four cycles and silently excluded management coverage.
disposition_reason: The five-cycle behavior and BMC-continuity objective are clear. Exact physical-to-netdev mapping and per-port role are runtime project parameters under the user's parameterization rule. The case can be resolved fail closed by requiring every named port to be explicitly assigned target or protected monitor, with no guessed management flap or omitted coverage.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row49 all18 XLSX cells and history2662.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized five-cycle per-port link flap with independent BMC continuity
test_case.purpose: Verify every authorized Ethernet target follows down/up behavior and recovers after five cycles while all protected BMC paths remain continuously available.
required_package: Physical port/MAC/BDF/netdev mapping for1G LAN, PDB BMC NIC and dedicated BMC NIC
Approved action-versus-monitor role for every named port
Independent console/OOB recovery path not traversing a flap target
Down/up dwell, carrier/traffic/BMC probes, recovery timeout and abort/final-state policy
test_case.test_command: Validate the signed port-role matrix and independent recovery path; capture link/routing/traffic/BMC baseline. For each authorized OS-controllable target, perform exactly five bounded down/up cycles, recording carrier, addressing and traffic failure/recovery each cycle. From the independent path continuously probe each protected BMC service. Restore every target to its recorded administrative state.
test_case.expected_result: Each target is unavailable only while down, restores carrier/address/traffic within the approved timeout for all five cycles, protected BMC services remain continuously healthy, and no persistent network/platform error occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires all named ports accounted for, exactly five cycles on every target, per-cycle functional recovery and uninterrupted BMC monitoring. One cycle or an omitted BMC identity cannot pass.
safety_gate: Never infer interface identity or flap the sole management/recovery path.
Require independent console/OOB and service-impact approval before any down action.
Reject bond/bridge/storage/cluster members unless specifically authorized.
Abort on recovery timeout, BMC loss, routing drift or platform error; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Baseline/final interface, route and BMC state
Five timestamped down/up/carrier/traffic records per target
Complete logs, abort state and final restoration
test_case.recovery: If a target does not recover or a protected BMC path drops, stop further cycles, use only the prevalidated independent console to restore the recorded administrative state, preserve link/routing/BMC logs, and require network/BMC owner review before any additional flap.
